source.description: One-time baseline of the six original brand definitions before pattern-explorations were installed. Canonical JSON SHA-256 hashes sort object keys and retain array order. Legacy vector/text SHA-256 hashes use planKit with local brand fonts, excluding rebuildable brand.json source paths. Recorded explicitly from git show; tests must never regenerate this fixture.

overtheedge.description: Explicit OTE baseline refresh for the requested original stacked cover masthead, supplied Salted and Helvetica Neue fonts, optional subtext metadata, and original Staff Card package. Supporting pattern-explorations entries are excluded, matching the source definition before collection installation. Other brands retain the original baseline.
